messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: gpu-pool-eu-west hitting 100% allocatable, queue growth detected, severity P2 -> paging oncall

maya: seeing 5k queued inference requests, latency spikes to 6s p95, throttling kicking in

tom: oncall here, ack. looking at autoscaler logs now. which nodegroup is targeted?

jess: autoscaler is trying to create nodegroup gpu-prod-eu-* but API calls failing with AttachRole error 403 on CreateLaunchConfiguration

maya: exact error from asg: \"InstanceProfile: arn:aws:iam::xxxx:instance-profile/gpu-node-profile is invalid or missing\"

oncall-sre: checking K8s cluster-autoscaler output: \`scale_up: adding 3 nodes (max cluster scale reached?)\` then \`Failed to register instances: launch config mismatch\`

infra-eng: looks like last launch-config rollout (v18) didn't propagate to the autoscaling group. ASG references lc-16. LC16 lacks the required iam instance-profile. Deploy bot last changed launch-config 2h ago.

maya: customers: a subset of real-time endpoints degrade to 503s when requests leave queue >30s. CS notified?

cs-rep: pinged a handful of customers via status page, currently marking as degraded for eu-west inference. no major enterprise SLA breaches yet but a few time-sensitive tenants reported failures.

oncall-sre: quick mitigation proposals: 1) manual scale-up of a pre-provisioned backup nodegroup with correct LC, 2) temporarily remove node taint to allow GPU scheduling on mixed pool, 3) enable CPU fallback for critical tenants.

tom: I'm going to create the backup nodegroup from snapshot: 

```
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-backup-eu --launch-configuration-name lc-v18-backup --min-size 1 --max-size 10 --desired-capacity 4 --tags Key=Name,Value=gpu-backup
```

jess: hold on, ASG creation will fail if IAM instance-profile not attached to LC. infra-eng can you confirm lc-v18-backup has instance-profile gpu-node-profile?

infra-eng: confirmed lc-v18-backup references gpu-node-profile. I'll run attach policy to the role just in case. doing now.

kube-bot: cluster-autoscaler log snippet: \"Failed to scale up: No launches available matching current template; taint mismatch on kubelet labels\"

oncall-sre: while infra finishes, I'm going to manually cordon some CPU-only nodes and evict low-priority pods to free room for critical CPU fallback lanes.

maya: creating a temporary rate-limit at the ingress for non-critical tenants to slow queue growth: 

```
# apply rate-limit
kubectl -n ingress patch configmap ratelimit --patch '{"data":{"global":"100rps"}}'
```

cs-rep: posting update to status page: "Mitigations in progress: scaling backup GPU pool and temporary rate-limits applied. Reduced capacity for non-critical workloads."

tom: ASG gpu-backup-eu created and instances are launching, first 2 registered to cluster. kubelet labels OK, taint for gpu present. I'm going to remove the gpu:reserved taint from those nodes temporarily: 

```
kubectl taint nodes node-abc gpu:reserved:NoSchedule-  # remove taint
```

jess: removing taint will allow non-GPU pods to land on GPU nodes; ok for short window but monitor memory pressure.

infra-eng: attach role fix pushed to LC sequence: LC v18 bumped, ASG updated to point to new LC. Confirmed instance profile fix.

oncall-sre: autoscaler retried scale-up and succeeded, added 4 more nodes. queue drain rate improved, p95 latency falling back to ~400ms.

maya: customer impact: ~12 production tenants saw brief 10-30s errors, two reported request spikes; CS has mitigations notes and will follow up with RM for those customers.

cs-rep: posting follow-up to affected customers and offering deeper post-incident follow-up as needed.

tom: root cause hypothesis so far: launch-config rollout produced inconsistent instance-profile reference (lc16 vs lc18), combined with a kubelet taint change that caused the autoscaler to consider templates incompatible -> ASG creation failed -> autoscaler retried and hit scale limits/permissions -> queue grew and ingress throttled.

jess: immediate action items: 1) infra to reconcile LC/ASG references and add a guard in deploy pipeline to prevent ASG/LC drift, 2) runtime to add a quick-detect alert for LC/ASG launchconfig mismatch, 3) add automated fallback to reserved capacity when scale-up fails.

infra-eng: ack. I'll open infra ticket and start pipeline patch. Also will add a preflight check step `aws autoscaling describe-launch-configurations` vs ASG reference in deploy job.

oncall-sre: followups: revert taint removal after drain completes, validate no OOM churn, make sure node labels match expected selectors.

maya: thanks team, I'll write a short incident summary and coordinate a postmortem. leaving notes in #postmortems and linking to this thread. please add any missing details. :thumbsup:
